import pytest
from string_utils import mask_email

def test_mask_email_single_char_local():
    """Test single-character local part (should return unchanged)."""
    assert mask_email("a@example.com") == "a@example.com"

def test_mask_email_long_local():
    """Test long local part (should mask with *)."""
    assert mask_email("jsmith@example.com") == "j*****@example.com"

def test_mask_email_empty_local():
    """Test empty local part (should raise ValueError)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("@example.com")

def test_mask_email_empty_domain():
    """Test empty domain (should raise ValueError)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: empty local part or domain"):
        mask_email("user@")

def test_mask_email_missing_at():
    """Test missing '@' (should raise ValueError)."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid email: missing '@'"):
        mask_email("userexample.com")

import pytest
from string_utils import truncate_with_ellipsis


def test_truncate_with_ellipsis_zero_length():
    """Test that max_len == 0 yields empty string."""
    assert truncate_with_ellipsis("hello", 0) == ""


def test_truncate_with_ellipsis_negative_max_len():
    """Test that negative max_len raises ValueError."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="max_len must be non-negative"):
        truncate_with_ellipsis("hello", -1)


def test_truncate_with_ellipsis_already_fits():
    """Test that text shorter than max_len is returned unchanged."""
    assert truncate_with_ellipsis("hi", 10) == "hi"


def test_truncate_with_ellipsis_hard_cut_on_small_max_len():
    """Test that max_len <= 3 triggers hard cut (no ellipsis)."""
    assert truncate_with_ellipsis("hello", 3) == "hel"
    assert truncate_with_ellipsis("a", 2) == "a"
    assert truncate_with_ellipsis("abc", 1) == "a"

import pytest

from numeric import integer_sqrt


def test_integer_sqrt_raises_on_negative():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="n must be non-negative"):
        integer_sqrt(-1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="n must be non-negative"):
        integer_sqrt(-1000)


def test_integer_sqrt_small_non_perfect():
    assert integer_sqrt(2) == 1
    assert integer_sqrt(5) == 2
    assert integer_sqrt(6) == 2
    assert integer_sqrt(7) == 2
    assert integer_sqrt(8) == 2
    assert integer_sqrt(9) == 3


def test_integer_sqrt_large_perfect():
    assert integer_sqrt(2**32) == 2**16  # 2^32 is perfect square


def test_integer_sqrt_exact_boundary():
    assert integer_sqrt(1000000000000000000) == 1000000000  # 10^18 is perfect square

import pytest

from date_utils import is_leap_year


def test_leap_year_divisible_by_400():
    """Test century years divisible by 400 are leap years."""
    assert is_leap_year(2000) is True
    assert is_leap_year(2400) is True
    assert is_leap_year(1600) is True


def test_leap_year_divisible_by_4_not_100():
    """Test years divisible by 4 but not 100 are leap years."""
    assert is_leap_year(2020) is True
    assert is_leap_year(2012) is True
    assert is_leap_year(2004) is True


def test_leap_year_divisible_by_100_not_400():
    """Test century years not divisible by 400 are not leap years."""
    assert is_leap_year(1800) is False
    assert is_leap_year(2100) is False
    assert is_leap_year(2200) is False


def test_leap_year_divisible_by_4_not_100_and_400():
    """Test years divisible by 4, 100, and 400 are leap years."""
    assert is_leap_year(2000) is True
    assert is_leap_year(1600) is True
    assert is_leap_year(2400) is True

import pytest
from containers import flatten


def test_flatten_with_nested_tuples():
    """Test that nested tuples are flattened correctly."""
    result = flatten([(1, 2), (3, (4, 5))])
    assert result == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]


def test_flatten_with_max_depth_zero_raises_value_error_nested():
    """Test that max_depth=0 raises ValueError even with nested structure."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nesting too deep"):
        flatten([1, [2, [3]], 4], max_depth=0)


def test_flatten_with_max_depth_one_raises_value_error_if_nested():
    """Test that max_depth=1 raises ValueError if nested beyond one level."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nesting too deep"):
        flatten([1, [2, [3]], 4], max_depth=1)


def test_flatten_with_max_depth_two_raises_value_error_if_nested_three_levels():
    """Test that max_depth=2 raises ValueError if nested three levels deep."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="nesting too deep"):
        flatten([1, [2, [3, [4]]]], max_depth=2)

import pytest
from parsers import parse_version


def test_version_valid_edge_cases():
    assert parse_version("1.0.0") == (1, 0, 0)
    assert parse_version("0.1.0") == (0, 1, 0)
    assert parse_version("0.0.1") == (0, 0, 1)
    assert parse_version("1.0.1") == (1, 0, 1)


def test_version_with_v_edge_cases():
    assert parse_version("v1.0.0") == (1, 0, 0)
    assert parse_version("v0.1.0") == (0, 1, 0)
    assert parse_version("v0.0.1") == (0, 0, 1)
    assert parse_version("v1.0.1") == (1, 0, 1)


def test_version_raises_on_invalid_format():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="expected major.minor.patch"):
        parse_version("1.2")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="expected major.minor.patch"):
        parse_version("1.2.3.4")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="expected major.minor.patch"):
        parse_version(".1.2.3")


def test_version_raises_on_non_numeric():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="non-numeric part"):
        parse_version("1.2.x")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="non-numeric part"):
        parse_version("1.2.3a")


def test_version_raises_on_out_of_range():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="part out of range"):
        parse_version("1000.1.2")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="part out of range"):
        parse_version("1.1000.2")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="part out of range"):
        parse_version("1.2.1000")
